remarks: Welcome Home! Discover this exceptional Condo Rental tucked away in The Chesterfield-one of Stamford's most sought-after gated communities. Enjoy resort-style living with two in-ground pools, a clubhouse, 24-hour security, and beautifully landscaped grounds. Located in a prime location directly across from Ridgeway Shopping Center. Walk to shops, gym, two grocery stores (Whole Foods is just up the street), plus easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and Metro-North. Step inside this spacious unit which has been beautifully updated throughout. The Living Room features gleaming hardwood floors, a fireplace, soaring ceilings with skylights, open to the dining area and kitchen boasting stainless steel appliances, granite counters, stone tile backsplash and washer/dryer. Step out the sliders to your private deck to relax and dine alfresco. There are two generously sized bedrooms and two renovated baths, including a primary suite with double closets and en-suite bath. In summer, enjoy lounging by the pool or take a short walk downtown to experience all Stamford has to offer, shops, dining, and entertainment. Included are two unassigned parking spaces and abundant guest parking. Tenant pays electricity, which includes heat which runs $242/mo average for the year. Tenants must have Excellent Credit and References. Sorry, no pets.
